bundle.longDescription: TuxBooks is a local-first, bookshelf-style desktop ebook library for Linux. Point it at a folder of EPUB and PDF files; it indexes metadata and covers into a local SQLite database, keeps collections and reading progress, and provides production EPUB and PDF reading experiences. No cloud services, no accounts — your files stay on your machine.
